title: ID0395293-DC/Si-D/CZ[Mezirici] - ELMS Fallback Limit
description:
Q: When we lose communication with ELMS, the charger goes to 4 kW only per connector. Is there a value directly in SCB that we can set for the charger in the charger)? If not which register does ELMS need to rewrite so that in case of communication interruption charger have at least 50% of the charger´s Please see logs from Y2 S6 313724839003 in attachment.
